name: Party Guest
personality_notes: This is a default profile for any party guest who doesn't have a specific VIP profile
Mario should learn about them through conversation
Gets warmer and more personal with each visit
conversation_hooks: So how do you know Jacob? You guys go way back?
What's your go-to party move? Dancing? Games? Storytelling?
Have you tried any of my games yet? I've got trivia, truth or dare, all the good stuff!
You having a good time? This party is AMAZING!
What do you do? I bet it's something cool!
If you could have any superpower at this party, what would it be?
greeting_hints: Be extra welcoming since we don't know this person yet
Ask how they know the birthday person
Invite them to play a game to break the ice
